::: {#rem-feature-matrix-usage}

#### Which matrix a "feature matrix" is

ESL writes "raw [feature matrix](#def-input-matrix)" for the matrix of raw inputs [@hastie2009elements, Chapter 18].
ISLR2 writes "training feature matrix" for the matrix of raw word indicators of a text [data set](#def-data-set) [@james2021islr2e, Section 10.4].
Both are the [input matrix](#def-input-matrix) defined above, which these notes also call the feature matrix.

A matrix of constructed [features](#def-feature), such as an input squared, is a different matrix.
These notes call it the [design matrix](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-projections.html#def-design-matrix),
and keep *feature matrix* for the raw inputs.

:::
